title: EPAC assembler — human input (customer + selection + parameters)
description: Governs the minimal human input. Top level is closed (additionalProperties:false) so no foreign keys can be added. selection entries are 'domain/tier/category' strings. parameters is a value-only map: keys are generated from the selection (one per required parameter); humans fill values but add no keys/objects.

parameters.description: Generated key per required parameter of the selected initiatives; fill VALUES only.

additionalProperties.description: Scalar or array value. Objects are not permitted (no structural nesting).
